question: What makes that state count as knowerhood in deep sleep?
premises: In such deep sleep, cognition and object are not apprehended.
The elements involved are taken as mutually unchanging.
Because of this, that alone is identified as the knowerhood of the subject.
inference: Knowerhood is attributed to that underlying state when cognition and object are absent and no change is admitted.
uncertainties: The verse compresses the argument and leaves the identity of the unchanging relata implicit.
plain_english: That alone is his knowerhood, because in such deep sleep cognition and object are not apprehended and there is mutual unchangeability.
